high_level_description: The image is a slide from a presentation titled "Robotic Manipulation with VFS." The slide discusses an approach that enables Value Function Space (VFS) to plan out complex robotic manipulation tasks using a model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) algorithm. Title: The title at the top of the slide reads "Robotic Manipulation with VFS." Main Text: The main body of the slide explains how the MBRL algorithm can be used to plan complex robotic manipulation tasks. It mentions that the MBRL algorithm uses a simple one-step predictive model
